cards.design_implication: If Raman spectroscopy is selected for layer number determination, the measurement calibration must define peak identification criteria within the 80–300 cm<sup>−1</sup> frequency window.
does_not_establish: A universal calibration curve or equation for thickness determination
The signal-to-noise ratio requirements for the measurement
The effect of doping or strain on these specific peaks
cards.evidence_excerpt: Layer breathing modes (LBMs) can also be observed in the Raman spectra of FLGs, via their resonant overtones in the range 80–300 cm<sup>−1</sup>.
limitations: The text does not specify the required laser energy or wavelength for this observation.
The applicability is stated for few-layer graphene (FLG) and may not apply to single or bulk layers in the same manner.
cards.statement: Raman spectroscopy layer breathing modes can be observed in few-layer graphene via resonant overtones in the 80–300 cm<sup>−1</sup> range, scaling in frequency with layer number.

cards.design_implication: If low-contact-resistance electrical interconnection is a requirement, the process design must incorporate the specific plasma cleaning and thermal annealing steps cited.
does_not_establish: A general manufacturing standard for all graphene devices
The stability of this resistance over long-term use
The effect of these conditions on the graphene bulk properties
cards.evidence_excerpt: The best results to date, down to $1 0 ^ { - 7 } \Omega \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 2 }$ , were obtained for Au/Ti metallization with a $9 0 \texttt { s O } _ { 2 }$ plasma cleaning prior to the metallization, and a post-annealing at ∼460 °C for 15 min.
limitations: The result is presented as a specific experimental outcome from literature (ref. 168) and may not be universally reproducible across all sample qualities.
The high annealing temperature (460 °C) may limit compatibility with thermally sensitive substrates.
cards.statement: The contact resistance between graphene and metals can be minimized to the $10^{-7} \Omega \mathrm{cm}^2$ range using Au/Ti metallization combined with plasma cleaning and post-annealing.
